gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.585063 39.978436)',4326)::geography, 700)
    AND p.leisure = 'garden'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 40;

WITH medical_building_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.585063, 39.978436), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffer_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geom, 700) AS geom
  FROM medical_building_geom
),
gardens_in_buffer AS (
  SELECT p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  JOIN buffer_geom b ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geometry, b.geom::geometry)
  WHERE p.leisure = 'garden'
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS garden_count
  FROM gardens_in_buffer g
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, g.geometry::geometry, TRUE))).sum / NULLIF((ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, g.geometry::geometry, TRUE))).count, 0) AS avg_elevation
    FROM public.dem_us r
    WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, g.geometry::geometry)
  ) stats ON TRUE
  WHERE avg_elevation <= 40
)
SELECT garden_count
FROM elevation_analysis;
